headline: Nevish Line Works Change Hands; Weathered Expanse Keeps Up the Din
war_summary: Part of the Nevish Line has changed hands since the last edition: where it then stood seven Warden works to one Colonial, it now reads six Warden and two Colonial, after forty-seven actions in the past day, four of them inside two hours. Princefal, Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother remain the busiest points, and the latest reports arrive at this hour. In Weathered Expanse a Warden work has passed from the rolls; the expanse, then five Colonial, two Warden and two unclaimed, now stands five Colonial, one Warden and three unclaimed, with fifty-three actions in the day and Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk the storm centres. Marban Hollow holds its four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed, though thirty-two actions fell about Checkpoint Bua. Kuura Strand's tangle about Faden Point continues at thirty-three actions, and Linn Mercy's works stand at nine Colonial, one Warden and one unclaimed, its fighting centred on Lathair. Callahan's Passage and the Dead Lands keep up their costly exchange without any change of colours, while Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf stay nearly still but dear.
